Vintage Can Driving is Very Fun is an overdrive pedal that can help to enhance the potential of any guitar sound. As with all our new series pedals, we have moved the switch to the right forward position for ease of use, as well as an easy to replace battery compartment. And we have updated our artwork with even more beautiful design features. While the basic function of the model is the same, we have expanded and fine-tuned the VVDVF to work with a wider variety of guitars and amplifiers. Single coil pickups sound clear and crisp, while humbuckers sound big and bold and articulate. Playing with a really great tone is one of the most important parts of making music. When you have a great sound that you are comfortable with, new licks flow effortlessly from your fingers and brain. Having a great tone means you can relax and play easier, which translates to a smoother and more organic sound. Also, if the tone is making YOU happy, your audience will be happier as well by feeling your sound and excitement. Playing with a great sound is like a lubricant that helps to create a positive feedback loop between you and the guitar. This is why there may never be an end to the exploration of great guitar tones. Some players prefer to use very little effects in their playing. The VVDVF is based on a classic low gain overdrive pedal from the 80s called the “BB” from the UK. We have attempted to get the best from this circuit, with the ability to boost a wide range of tone with the best quality possible – from a clean boost to a light overdrive. In the BOOST mode, you can push the amplifier to bring your tone more forward in the mix or you can use the VVDVF to boost your favorite distortion pedals. You can use this pedal to “warm up” your digital effectors and add depth to your tone in a modeling rig. From the high end of the harmonic spectrum to the midrange (the true core of your guitar tones) and to the low end that helps your tonal foundation, the VVDVF creates a good balance tonally, refined but also a little wild.
